scope: scripts/qualify_platform_lifecycle.py on Debug builds of 339ebb2d in one owned TIA V21 scratch (CPU 1511-1 PN): project_save with nothing to save, refusals of project_archive, project_close and project_open_copy over an unsaved edit (UnsavedProject), project_save of it; project_archive compressed and discardRestorableDataAndCompressed with hash-checked archives, an unknown mode refused; project_open_copy archiveAndRetrieve with equal inventory; project_close refusing and then discarding an unsaved edit in the copy; read-only reopen, project_archive refused there (ReadOnlyProject), project_save refused (ReadOnlyProject), project_open_copy closeAndCopyFolder; project_retrieve of the archive with equal inventory; a fresh owned PLCSIM instance provisioned without TLS trust held the attempt, simulation_provision_status listed it with its next calls, project_save was refused (ResourceBusy) and simulation_provision_recover detached, started, reconciled and reopened the scratch.
limitations: TIA's Project.Archive writes into the open project's folder (observed: the .ap21, XRef.db, ProjectInfo.txt, System/PEData.*, the .info file); the report lists the files each step wrote. Content preservation is checked through the inventory and an unmodified project, not byte equality.

The trusted (successful) provisioning path is not part of this evidence; on 26 November it twice hit the card-staging access denial (0x80070005, no Restart Manager holder) when restoring the card. UMAC-protected projects are not covered.

steps: project folder files written by Project.Archive
original folder files written by project_open_copy (read-write)
original folder files written by the read-only open and copy
original folder files written by project_retrieve
